# 2 Baruch Chapter 83 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**1** "So hear, O Israel, and be taught, O children of Jacob. Prepare yourselves for the holy days that are coming."

**2** "The days are coming when Jerusalem will be rebuilt, the exiles will return, and Zion will be lived in again."

**3** "The temple will be reconstructed and sacrifices will again be offered on the altar."

**4** "The priests will return to their service and the Levites to their duties."

**5** "The law will stay with you, the commandments will be carried out, and the covenant of the Holy One will last forever."

**6** "But for now, listen to me: do not abandon the commandments of the Mighty One, and do not chase after the practices of the nations."

**7** "The nations will perish, the Gentiles will be destroyed — but Israel will endure forever."

**8** "The descendants of Jacob will live on forever, and all that is passing away will come to its end."

**9** "Now hear me, my brothers. I am deeply worried for you, because I know there are those among you who have abandoned the covenant."

**10** "They will be reckoned as Gentiles and will receive the fate of the nations."

**11** "For you are my brothers, the name of Israel has been given to you, and you were set apart from the nations to be holy."

**12** "But you have lived like the Gentiles and abandoned the law of the Mighty One."

**13** "I appeal to you now: search your hearts, turn from your evil ways, and come back to the Lord your God."

**14** "He will have mercy on you just as he had mercy on your ancestors."

**15** "He will not abandon you or desert you; instead he will restore you and stay with you."

**16** "For the law itself says: 'The Lord your God is a merciful God; he will not abandon you, he will not destroy you, and he will not forget the covenant he made with your ancestors.'"

**17** "So brothers, do not despair. The tribulation will end, and the time of suffering will pass."

**18** "The Mighty One will gather you again from all the nations where you have been scattered."

**19** "He will bring you back to Zion, restore the holy temple to you, and return the sacred vessels."

**20** "You will live again in the holy land, you will have peace, and the nations will never oppress you again."

**21** "You will be called children of the Mighty One, children of the Holy One, and you will inherit the holy land forever."

**22** "You will be blessed, and the whole earth will be blessed along with you."

**23** "The Mighty One will not forget his people, and will not ignore his own inheritance."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
